messages:
sam: Heads-up — proposal to change the internal routing header shape that SDKs emit. Trying to fold route policy + quota hint into a single compact header to reduce proxy parsing work.

sam: Current shape is two headers (`X-Redwood-Route` + `X-Redwood-Quota`) and we want to move to one JSON-ish header: `Redwood-Route: version=2;payload=ey...` (base64 payload).

sam: Reasoning: single header is easier for some proxies and avoids multiple lookups, also lets us atomically version hints.

linh: @sam can you drop a concrete example of the new wire format? curious about size and how SDKs decode it.

sam: Sure — high level: `Redwood-Route: v=2;fmt=json;base64=eyJwb2xpY3kiOiJuYXJyb3djYXN0IiwicXVvdGEiOiJzdGFuZGFyZCJ9`

sam: The payload decodes to `{\"policy\":\"narrowcast\",\"quota\":\"standard\"}`. We plan to gzip then base64 for bigger payloads in future.

maya: This will affect console telemetry and the route breakdown tile. We currently rely on `X-Redwood-Route` being plain JSON. How do you see migration working? :thinking_face:

omar: From Console: if we get a single header we can still parse it server-side but we need a graceful fallback for older SDKs that send the two-header format. Also we need to know the exact keys we should depend on for dashboards (policy, quota, affinity_tag).

elena: Runtime concern — some of our edge proxies have a 4KB header limit. Base64+gzip could inflate some requests if customers attach larger metadata. We should keep v2 *optional* and have SDKs emit it only when hints are short. Also need to confirm binary-safe routing through our proxies.

linh: From SDKs: we can implement both encoders/decoders and a header negotiation step, but that means a minor version bump across py/ts/go. We prefer to avoid breaking users. Timeline?

sam: Plan: soft rollout — SDKs add v2 support behind a feature flag. By default, continue emitting old headers. After 6 weeks of rollout & telemetry, flip default. Sunsetting old format after 12 weeks.

linh: That helps. Two implementation questions: 1) how do we negotiate with the server to know which header to use? 2) is there a canonical lib for encoding (gzip+base64) we should import?

sam: Negotiation: server echoes supported versions in a `Redwood-Server-Flags` response header on model init path. SDKs should cache per-host for N minutes. If server advertises `route-v2` then emit v2. Fallback: if server returns 415 or we see parsing errors in response metadata, revert to v1.

omar: For dashboards we only need stable keys: `policy`, `quota`, `affinity` (affinity may be optional). Please document exact key names and allowed values — console will map them to tiles.

sam: Agreed — I'll add a spec in the internal API repo: allowed policies = [narrowcast, broadcast, fallback], quota = [standard, premium, burst], affinity = string.

elena: Also add a size guideline: payload must be <= 512 bytes before encoding. If SDKs have larger payloads, they should either truncate affinity metadata or set `affinity=auto-hash`.

linh: For the SDK release plan: we'll add a `route.v2.enabled` flag, default=false, and a helper `redwood.route.format()` util. We'll also add a migration guide in each SDK with example snippets.

maya: UX ask from DevEx: can we provide a console opt-in toggle to force using v2 for a specific customer so that support can help customers test? That'd reduce noisy rollouts.

omar: Yes — console can expose a per-customer flag that toggles `route-v2` in the server flags. We'll need an authenticated API for it.

linh: Quick note on telemetry: SDKs will emit an event `sdk.route.header.format` with values `v1_emitted`, `v2_emitted`, `negotiated_v2`, `fallback_v1`. We'll sample it at 100% for the first 2 weeks. OK?

sam: Perfect. Also add a lightweight preflight in the SDK where it sends a no-op `GET /internal/ping` that returns supported flags — to avoid paying for model tokens during negotiation.

elena: One more — security review. Base64 payload should be validated server-side and never logged. Avoid including any customer PII in affinity.

linh: Ack. We'll add unit tests and an e2e with a test proxy that simulates header limits.

deploy-bot: preflight check passed for `eng-platform/route-header-v2-spec` — open PR 5421 created by sam.

maya: Sounds like we're aligned. @linh please start the SDK branch, we can coordinate the console toggle + flagging with @omar. Let's keep the rollout behind flags and watch the `sdk.route.header.format` telemetry. :thumbsup:

linh: Will do. I'll post the SDK branch link and a short changelog when ready.

sam: Thanks all — I'll drop the spec link in here once PR lands.
